title: The Canopy Still Becoming

features.name: fresh shoot archive
features.desc-on-touch: Growth spilling into recording systems. Leaves learning to photosynthesize data. The forest documents itself by growing through the documentation.

features.name: observation becoming root
features.desc-on-touch: The cameras that watched growth are now rooted in place, their lenses clouded by the very leaves they were meant to record. The archive watches itself being absorbed.

features.name: five-year emergence
features.desc-on-touch: Where empty air stood in the records five years ago, now branches thick enough to perch on. The archive's data showed emptiness; the forest showed preparation.

features.name: growth writing itself
features.desc-on-touch: Ring-count and ring-read are the same act here. Each season inscribes while being witnessed. The forest documents by living; the document lives by recording.

features.name: unmapped canopy layer
features.desc-on-touch: The highest branches are emerging faster than taxonomy can follow. Each new node of growth is alive before it can be named. The forest becomes itself first.

features.name: light reaching new height
features.desc-on-touch: The archive documents light's journey downward. But upward, the canopy is racing toward new light, and that upward growth is not yet filed.

inscription: the forest grew while being read, and learned that growth and reading are forms of each other

file.name: Canopy_Survey_Incomplete_Updated_Every_Season.csv
file.note: status: germinating — height, branch-count, leaf-density records lag behind actual growth by one phenological season. The archive is always behind.
